data.locator: Documentation of mechanical, chemical and biological monitoring; positive biological-indicator workflow; maintenance and load recall/reprocessing
data.source_setting: CDC guidance for healthcare-facility sterilization and central processing
data.source_n: Not applicable; equipment-management guidance, not a local asset census or utilization study.
data.source_evidence_basis: CDC describes mechanical, chemical and biological monitoring records, documentation and actions after positive biological indicators including taking equipment out of service, coordinating with infection control and maintenance, and reprocessing affected loads when indicated.
data.limitations: Sources establish general health-technology-management and infection-prevention requirements, not a particular hospital inventory, vendor model, staffing plan, utilization rate, maintenance interval, or service-time distribution. Family-specific asset presence and all local values remain unknown.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Represent sterilizer availability separately from sterile-instrument inventory; associate each load with cycle record and release/quarantine state, and link failed cycles to affected packs and reprocessing. Specific monitoring cadence and retention follow applicable local standards/policy; do not assume a universal throughput.
